text:
```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: actions/setup-php@v4
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: mbstring, intl
          coverage: none

      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: composer install --no-progress --prefer-dist

      - name: Run Behat tests
        run: vendor/bin/behat

      - name: Run audit command with JSON format
        run: vendor/bin/wp i18n audit --format=json

      - name: Run audit command with GitHub Actions format
        run: vendor/bin/wp i18n audit --format=github-actions
```
